title: The Ground Can Explode With a Boom When It Freezes Fast

scenes.text: Sometimes the ground booms like a car crashed into your house.
Soaked soil freezes fast when the air drops fifteen degrees or more in a few hours.
The water turns to ice and expands, and the ground suddenly cracks.
You hear a bang, windows rattle, but neighbors down the street may feel nothing.
A tiny earthquake made by ice.

description:
A frost quake happens when waterlogged soil freezes so fast that the expanding ice cracks the ground with a boom.
It needs wet ground, a rapid deep freeze, and little snow cover.
Have you ever heard one?
first_comment: Have you ever been woken up by a mysterious boom?
